problem_array.name: p_13_1_rectangle_area
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: provide a recursive getArea method that computes the area of a rectangle.

dafny.method_signature: p_13_1_rectangle_area(width: int, height: int) returns (area: int)
dafny.functional_code:
function rect_area(width: int, height: int) : int
  requires 0 <= width && 0 <= height
  ensures rect_area(width, height) == width * height
{
  if width == 0 || height == 0 then 0
  else rect_area(width - 1, height) + height
}

problem_array.name: p_13_2_square_area_method
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: provide a recursive getArea method that computes the area of a square.

dafny.functional_code:
function square_area(width: int) : int
  requires 0 <= width
  ensures square_area(width) == width * width
{
  if width == 0 then 0
  else square_area(width - 1) + 2 * width - 1
}

problem_array.name: p_13_3_reverse_string_method
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: Write a recursive method String reverse(String text) that reverses a string. For example, reverse("Hello!") returns the string "!olleH". Implement a recursive solution by removing the first character, reversing the remaining text, and combining the two.

ensures: forall i :: 0 <= i < |text| ==> reversed[i] == text[|text| - 1 - i]

problem_array.name: p_13_5_reverse_string_iterative
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: Write an iterative method String reverse(String text) that reverses a string. For example, reverse("Hello!") returns the string "!olleH".

ensures: forall i :: 0 <= i < |text| ==> reversed[i] == text[|text| - 1 - i]

problem_array.name: p_13_6_find_string
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: Use recursion to implement a method public static boolean find(String text, String str) that tests whether a given text contains a string. For example, find("Mississippi", "sip") returns true. Hint: If the text starts with the string you want to match, then you are done. If not, consider the text that you obtain by removing the first character.

dafny.method_signature: p_13_6_find_string(text: seq<char>, str: seq<char>) returns (found: bool)
ensures: found == (exists i :: 0 <= i <= |text| - |str| && starts_with(text[i..], str) == true)

problem_array.name: p_13_7_index_of_string
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: Use recursion to implement a method public static int indexOf(String text, String str) that returns the starting position of the first substring of the text that matches str. Return –1 if str is not a substring of the text. For example, s.indexOf("Mississippi", "sip") returns 6. Hint: You must keep track of how far the match is from the beginning of the text. Make that value a parameter variable of a helper method.

dafny.method_signature: p_13_7_index_of_string(text: seq<char>, str: seq<char>) returns (index: int)

problem_array.name: p_13_10_compute_polygon_area
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: Using recursion, compute the area of a polygon. Cut off a triangle and use the fact that a triangle with corners (x1 , y1), (x2, y2 ), (x3, y3) has area |x1(y2 – y3) + x2(y3 – y1) + x3(y1 – y2)| / 2 this assumes that polygon points are given in order either clockwise or counterclockwise.
